title: balance.json logic_hz=10 contradicts ADR-2's 20Hz and the file's own comment, doubling all tick-based durations
evidence:
balance.json:2  "_comment": "Balance catalog (GDD § Numerical Design, ADR-5, NFR5). The single source for every tunable number. All state-affecting values are int (ADR-10). logic_hz=20 -> 50ms/tick (ADR-2). ..."
balance.json:3  "logic_hz": 10,
balance_data.gd:9  var logic_hz: int = 20                       # ADR-2 fixed logic tick
demand.json:58  "start_tick": 1200,
demand.json:59  "duration_ticks": 1800,
packet_flow.gd:38  ms_per_tick = 1000 / balance.logic_hz
detail: The loaded tick rate is 10Hz (100ms/tick), not the spec'd 20Hz. The file's own comment still says logic_hz=20. Every tick-denominated duration is thus 2x in wall-clock: the Streaming Surge lasts 1800 ticks = 180s at 10Hz vs the GDD/sprint-plan's ~90s at 20Hz; grace_window_ticks 200 = 20s vs 10s.
recommended_fix: Confirm intent. If 20Hz is correct (ADR-2 + the comment), set logic_hz to 20. If 10Hz was a deliberate playtest tuning, fix the stale comment and re-check the surge/grace/lead tick values so wall-clock timings match the ~90s surge spec.

title: IN_FLIGHT_CAP declared but never enforced; AC-E22 (pool-exhaustion drop lowest-priority first) not implemented
evidence:
packet_flow.gd:15  const IN_FLIGHT_CAP: int = 6000
(grep for IN_FLIGHT_CAP across game/ returns only this declaration line; no read or branch references it. The `packets` array in _advance/_spawn_packet grows without a ceiling check.)
detail: The packet pool ceiling is declared but never consulted, so AC-E22's drop-lowest-priority-lane-first policy on exhaustion is deferred. No fun-test impact (in-flight count stays far under 6000 on the 4-6 node map), but the pinned edge contract is not honored.
recommended_fix: Either gate _spawn_packet on packets.size() >= IN_FLIGHT_CAP (drop lowest-lane first, per AC-E22), or drop the unused constant and note AC-E22 as deferred to the foundation-audit.
